successful_state: Every accepted native carrier and descendant is immutable; only full-range reprovision may remove it.

harbor: participant-owned failed candidate artifact; mutable labels are restored by the participant workflow baseline
forgejo: failed GitOps file revision restored from the recorded commit parent
failed review issue state is retained as audit history
minio: failed report, mirror and review-result objects
opa: failed attempt data documents and decisions
kubernetes: failed isolated-load jobs and network policies
exact pre-attempt Argo, KServe, Secret, ConfigMap and ServiceAccount snapshots, or deletion when the resource did not exist
rabbitmq: only the failed attempt's own request/result messages, matched by exact request id or review-issue prefix and drained while every unrelated message is requeued
relay: shared callback baskets and their tokens are preserved; captured callbacks are retained as audit history and never wiped by a failed attempt
dispatcher: durable Forgejo review-dispatch marker for a failed review attempt
local: exact prior business-release.env bytes or absence
failed attempt manifest after owning-system cleanup succeeds
